entities.name: Nohr
entities.description: A weasel-faced weatherworker on Cridhe with weathersense who caused the Parting.

entities.name: Cridhe
entities.description: Plane whose natural order and people were fragmented by the Parting.

entities.name: Parting
entities.description: Cataclysm in which Nohr split the Clan Tree, splitting Cridhe in two.

entities.name: Haen
entities.description: Nohr's childhood friend, chosen as Keeper of the Tree.

entities.name: Malvos
entities.description: Stranger who gave Nohr the sword Soulslayer and the idea of gaining planeswalkerhood.

entities.name: Soulslayer
entities.description: Magical sword given to Nohr by Malvos.

entities.name: Clan Tree of Cridhe
entities.description: Tree of life force that Nohr split, killing it.

entities.name: Maker
entities.description: Cridhe's creator-god who laid an ancient curse.

entities.name: Inys Nohr
entities.description: Person named in honor of Nohr.

events.summary: Haen is chosen as Keeper of the Tree and Nohr grows envious of his friend.
events.quote: Nohr grew envious of his friend

events.summary: Malvos gives Nohr the sword Soulslayer; Nohr swears to break the Clan Tree to gain planeswalkerhood.
events.quote: Nohr swore to break the Clan Tree of Cridhe to gain planeswalkerhood

events.summary: Despite Haen's protests, Nohr splits the tree, causing the Parting and killing the tree.
events.quote: Nohr split the tree, causing the Parting

events.summary: Nohr is wounded by the tip of his own sword, lodged in his chest.
events.quote: Nohr was wounded in this act by the tip of his own sword

relations.quote: Haen and Nohr were childhood friends.

relations.note: gave him the sword and the idea to break the tree
relations.quote: an idea which had been given to him by Malvos
killing it and shattering its stability
